title: Synthesis of novel N1 functionalized diazepinone analogues via a base-mediated C–N cross coupling reaction as reverse transcriptase inhibitors: theoretical and experimental investigations
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29160-29175
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03504J, Paper

The sodium hydrogen orthophosphate base-mediated C–N coupling reaction was described for the synthesis of a novel series of dipyridodiazepinone derivatives as reverse transcriptase inhibitors.
